Project future monthly spend from current cost and plugin growth

## Synopsis

```text
Project the after-change monthly cost forward by month.

The current price comes from the same plan or state as cost projected.
A Terraform directory runs OpenTofu plan and show without init.
--terraform-plan reads saved show -json output; --terraform-state keeps reading
state without planning. Infrastructure input flags are mutually exclusive.
--include-workspace overrides cost.terraform.include_workspace for this run's
Terraform history identity. Pulumi ignores the setting.

Each plugin reports a growth model (none, linear, or exponential). Pass
--growth-rate to apply that model. The monthly price itself does not change.

Plain output is an ASCII chart. JSON and NDJSON emit timestamped series,
including stored cost history for --stack when that database exists and
uses the same currency. A missing history file does not fail the command.
```

```text
finfocus cost forecast [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  finfocus cost forecast --pulumi-json plan.json --growth-type linear --growth-rate 0.10
  finfocus cost forecast --stack prod --months 6 --growth-rate 0.05 --split-providers
  finfocus cost forecast --pulumi-json plan.json --growth-rate 0.05 --output json
```

      --adapter string                   Use only the specified adapter plugin

      --model string                     Forecast model: growth (plugin growth) or arima (fit --spend-history) (default "growth")
      --months int                       Months ahead to project, from 1 to 36, including the current month as the start (default 12)

      --no-color[=true|false]            Disable ANSI colors on the chart

      --output string                    Output format: plain, json, or ndjson (default "plain")
      --plain[=true|false]               Force the ASCII chart

      --pulumi-state string              Path to Pulumi stack export JSON

      --spend-history string             CSV of date,value spend rows, one per day or month (required with --model arima)
      --split-providers[=true|false]     Draw one series per provider on the chart
      --step stringArray                 Add AMOUNT per month from DATE's month on, as DATE=AMOUNT (repeatable)
      --terraform-plan string            Path to tofu show -json output; does not run tofu
